method: Closing Yamaha's US depth gap in docs/CATALOG-DEPTH.md against its whole range as counted in docs/research/catalog-ranges.json (motorcycles|Yamaha, range 25). Yamaha's own current US road-motorcycle lineup page (yamahamotorsports.com/motorcycles) lists exactly 24 models across Supersport, Hyper Naked, Sport Heritage, Touring, Dual Sport and Scooter, matching the 24 non-off-road names already enumerated in catalog-ranges.json's 'counted' field before its off-road YZ/WR/TT-R/PW50 entries begin. SLATE already held 22 of those 24; the 2 missing (YZF-R9, YZF-R1M) are added here with 2026 MSRPs read from Yamaha's own site. See rangeProblems: the recorded range of 25 appears to be off by one against Yamaha's own current lineup page.

rangeProblems.issue: catalog-ranges.json records a road-registerable range of 25 for Yamaha US, but Yamaha's own current motorcycles (road) lineup page at https://www.yamahamotorsports.com/motorcycles lists exactly 24 models: YZF-R9, YZF-R1M, YZF-R1, YZF-R7, YZF-R3 (Supersport); MT-10 SP, MT-10, MT-09 SP, MT-09, MT-07, MT-03 (Hyper Naked); BOLT R-SPEC, XSR900, XSR700, V STAR 250 (Sport Heritage); FJR1300ES, TENERE 700, TENERE 700 World Raid, TRACER 9 (Touring); XT250, TW200, WR125R (Dual Sport); XMAX, ZUMA 125 (Scooter). No 25th road model was found on this page or Yamaha's press materials read on 2026-10-06; the range should likely read 24, not 25.
